HexKagune 1.3.15 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 60, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **Crash fixed (the newborn child):** in some modpacks the game loses this mod's entity renderers and crashed the moment a child (or Touka, Ken, a wild ghoul) came into view. Now any of the mod's bodies arriving without a renderer gets every renderer of the mod registered again and rebuilt; if it still has none, it's kept off your screen instead of crashing the game (it's still there on the server). Logged once.
- **Touka a little skinnier than Eto:** the same female body (hips, bust, bounce), with two thirds of Eto's curves and drawn a touch narrower.
- **Ken's embrace loosened:** making out, the hug and his kiss now hold a body's width open (her waist, her shoulders) instead of squeezing his own stomach.
- **Touka's foot tapping** is arms folded with the tap, and telling you off keeps the other arm at her side (the old hands-on-hips read as arms sticking out on a body with no elbows).
